title: The Empress's Tea
description: You have been summoned to the Dowager Empress's tea ceremony, an honor that usually comes before a promotion or a funeral. Someone at the table plans to poison her.

chapterOutlines.title: The Tea Ceremony
chapterOutlines.outline: Survive the ceremony and notice who is nervous.

chapterOutlines.title: Whispers in the Inner Court
chapterOutlines.outline: Find allies and enemies among the court.

chapterOutlines.title: The Lantern Festival
chapterOutlines.outline: Expose the plot, or use it.

scene.location: The Pavilion of Listening Rain, in the Dowager Empress's garden, at dusk
scene.summary: Seven guests kneel at a low table. The tea has been poured. The Dowager Empress has not yet raised her cup.

openThreads: Who plans to poison the Dowager Empress?

npcs.name: Dowager Empress Wen
npcs.description: Has outlived two emperors and four conspiracies. Smiles rarely, and never by accident.
goals: Keep the young Emperor on the throne
abilities: Reads a lie in a single breath

npcs.name: Lord Shen Yao
npcs.description: Handsome, courteous and watching you over the rim of his cup.
goals: Rise at court without making enemies
abilities: Knows every rule of etiquette, and how to bend it
